changes.title: Stage and privately deliver verified TEST231
changes.text: Reuse the exact verified TEST231 APK, check source application inputs, checksum, signing, package and install-over version, and publish only the private owner preview without rebuilding or distributing to testers.

changes.title: Continue lifecycle recovery after one damaged payload
changes.text: Resume and segment recovery isolate malformed lifecycle payloads so later readable ruleset and segment state remains available; original history and gameplay stay unchanged.

commentary: TEST231 is the immediate previous produced and privately delivered APK. The lifecycle recovery correction requires exact before/after core evidence and one complete TEST232 application gate; no automatic delivery.
